database_clear_confirm_body: This deletes $works works and $history history entries. Library works and history, downloaded and local source files, settings and sources are kept. This cannot be undone.

db_cannot_open_message: MyComic could not open or create its database at the configured data location. Nothing is corrupt - the folder may be missing, read-only, or on a disconnected drive. Check the data location in Settings, or restart to use the default location.
db_downgrade_message: This database was created by a newer version of MyComic (schema v$dbVersion). Your current app is too old (v$appVersion). Opening was blocked to protect your data. Please update the app and try again.
db_legacy_schema_message: This database comes from the old Hibiki app or an early version (data schema older than v75), which this version can no longer upgrade directly. Your data has not been changed. To migrate: install MyComic v$version over this version (the bridge release that still contains the full upgrade path; your data folder is kept), open it once to upgrade the data, then update to the current version. On Android an older version cannot be installed over a newer one, and uninstalling MyComic also deletes this data, so back it up before uninstalling. Download: $url
db_legacy_schema_release_open: Open the MyComic v$version download page
db_legacy_schema_title: Old data needs an upgrade first
db_unrecoverable_message: The database could not be opened even after automatic repair. It is likely corrupt. You can restore a backup in Settings, or clear app data to start fresh.

Skipped: $incomplete incomplete folder(s), $ambiguous ambiguous work(s). Failed: $failed.

tag_picker_scope_members_hint: Tags go on every item inside the selected collections. The collections themselves stay unchanged.
tag_reorder_failed: Couldn't save the new tag order. Please try again.
theme_accent_auto_tone: Adjust tone for light and dark mode
theme_accent_auto_tone_desc: Off: the exact color is used. On: a lighter or darker tone is generated for each mode, so what you see differs from what you picked.
theme_accent_auto_tone_short: Separate tones for light and dark
theme_accent_follow_system_desc: Use the wallpaper color on Android (Material You) or the OS accent color on desktop instead of a picked color.
theme_accent_follow_system_short: Use the wallpaper or system accent
theme_accent_follow_system_unavailable: The system does not expose an accent color on this device.
theme_accent_low_contrast_dark: Hard to see on the dark-mode background. Pick a lighter color.
theme_accent_low_contrast_light: Hard to see on the light-mode background. Pick a darker color.
theme_icon_accent_hint: Take the accent color from your custom icon image. Turn off to return to the theme you picked.
theme_logo_tint_hint: Recolor the built-in mascot icon to match the accent color. When off, the original artwork is always shown.
theme_neutral_derived_desc: Tags, selected items, menus and surfaces stay gray instead of taking on the accent's hue; only the accent color itself stands out (like the Windows light theme). White, gray or black accents do this automatically.
theme_neutral_derived_short: Only the theme color carries hue
theme_preview_hint: Pick a color to see where it is used outlined in the preview.
theme_pure_black_hint: Use true black backgrounds in dark mode (OLED)
theme_role_accent_desc: Used exactly as picked for buttons, switches, icons and progress bars. Every other color is derived from it.
theme_role_audio_highlight_desc: Follows audiobook playback. Applies to every theme, not just this one.
theme_role_container_desc: Switch tracks, floating buttons and the play bar
theme_role_link_desc: Hyperlinks inside books and the selection handles
theme_role_reader_background_desc: Reader page, toolbar and dictionary popup background
theme_role_reader_text_desc: Reader text, toolbar icons and dictionary popup text
theme_role_secondary_desc: Tags, badges and selected list items
theme_role_selection_desc: Background of the word or sentence being looked up
theme_role_surface_desc: Base color of pages, cards and menus; the other layers get a faint tint of gray from it.
update_debug_channel_warning: Debug channel builds may be unstable. Use at your own risk.
update_download_source_unavailable: $source is not available for this file; falling back to the automatic order
update_install_gal_hook_holder: Galgame capture component in use: PID $pid - $path (this is the game you are playing, or its capture host). Close the game, then update again.
update_install_incomplete_message: The installer started, but MyComic is still on the previous version. Check the installer log below.
update_install_launch_failed_message: MyComic could not start the installer for version $version. Check the log path below.
update_install_log_not_observed: Installer log was not created during the post-launch check.
update_install_log_observed: Installer log was created during the post-launch check.
update_install_manual_close_retry: Close MyComic from the listed PID/path, then retry the update or run the installer again.
update_install_parent_exit_not_observed: The update launcher did not observe MyComic exiting before the installer launch.
update_install_parent_exit_observed: MyComic exited before the installer was launched.
update_install_permission_message: Please allow MyComic to install apps in system settings, then retry.
update_install_restart_windows_hint: If the listed processes are closed but libmpv-2.dll is still locked, restart Windows and install again.
update_mac_install_incomplete_message: The update could not be applied, so MyComic is still on the previous version. You can retry the update, or download the latest release manually.
updates_center_empty_hint: Subscribed anime, manga chapters, extension and app releases show up here.
updates_extension_auto_update_hint: On launch, install newer versions of manga and video extensions whose signature hasn't changed. If online sources were already opened, it waits until the next launch.
updates_history_clear_confirm_body: Remove all entries under "$scope"? Updates that are still pending, such as a newer app version you have not installed, will show up again on the next check.
updates_notify_manga_chapter_hint: Check followed online manga for new chapters in the background.
updates_notify_manga_extension_hint: Alert when an installed extension has a newer version in its repository.
updates_system_notifications_hint: Also send a system notification. Turning this off keeps the in-app badge.
video_control_reject_unavailable: This control cannot be placed there.
video_discovery_provider_failed: Some sources failed temporarily; showing the rest
video_discovery_provider_rate_limited: Some sources are rate limited; showing the rest
video_discovery_provider_warning: Some providers are unavailable. Showing available results.
video_subtitle_color_note: Subtitle colors are set inside the video player.
